pretreatments.description: Debarking of pinewood feedstock into small pieces using a carpentry chopper.
Cutting of the chopped pieces into small pieces using a carpentry chopper.
Powdering using a grinder (Bosch MKM6003, Germany).
Sodium hydroxide (NaOH) pretreatment at 100 °C for 10 min with 8% wt. NaOH solution.
Biological pretreatment at 37 °C and 90 rpm for 10 days using aerobic sludge.
Ultrasonic pretreatment at 180 W, 40 kHz, 30 min, and 40 °C.
